subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` as the supported opt-in public contract for releasing and fencing wedged deferred context-engine maintenance?
rationale: The PR adds a user-configurable policy affecting plugin maintenance duration, session liveness, late transcript/task mutations, and shutdown handling; that permanent contract cannot be selected safely by automation.

options.title: Accept the opt-in contract
options.body: Keep absent or zero as disabled and document a positive millisecond value as the operator-selected bound, subject to an exact-head upgrade and lifecycle review.

options.title: Reuse an existing policy surface
options.body: Reject the new setting and request a narrower implementation based on an existing documented timeout or recovery contract if one is preferred.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define the intended timeout and late-worker policy for public context-engine plugins.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Keep absent or zero as disabled and document a positive millisecond value as the operator-selected bound, subject to an exact-head upgrade and lifecycle review.
